ideas.title: Investigating ICE Misconduct
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the allegations of misconduct against the ICE director and the agency's actions.
questions: What are the allegations against the ICE director?
How has the agency responded to the allegations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and hold those in power accountable. I recommend starting with a thorough review of the court documents and conducting interviews with key stakeholders.
